Done and verified. I built **PD·8 — a pocket drum machine** at `index.html`, live at http://localhost:4600/preview/. It's a hardware-faceplate design (warm plastic body, green LCD, colored step pads) and it actually works: 4 tracks × 8 steps, WebAudio-synthesized kick/snare/hat/clap (no audio files), lookahead scheduler for tight timing, tempo ±, clear, spacebar play/stop, playhead lighting on pads + LCD. The grid already contains Haiku’s persistence changes, so I’m keeping my edit isolated to track-row styling, track control creation, and scheduler gating. Mute will silence that track; any active solo will silence all non-solo tracks, while preserving programmed steps.

I caught a live integration issue from the concurrent persistence edit: its initial UI sync runs before `lcdBpm` is initialized, which would stop the whole script at startup. I’m making the smallest ordering fix—moving that call below the LCD element bindings—so both features can run together.

messages.name: Claude
messages.text:
Verification complete — everything works. Full pass done in the browser, screenshot saved as **verify.png** (shows PD·8 playing with snare muted).

**Results:**
- ✅ **Mute** — snare M toggles `is-silent` + `aria-pressed`, visual state correct
- ✅ **Solo** — soloing hat marks it `is-solo` and silences all other tracks; audibility logic (`!muted && (!anySolo || solo)`) behaves right
- ✅ **Saving** — pattern + BPM write to `localStorage` on every step toggle and survive a full page reload (verified with a cleared store, toggled steps, reload)
- ✅ **Playback** — play button starts/stops, playhead advances (step 2→4 observed), LCD dot tracks it
- ✅ **Console** — zero errors/warnings across all interactions and reloads

Two notes, not bugs: Space intentionally defers to a focused button (so clicking a step then pressing Space toggles that step — standard browser behavior), and mute/solo state is *not* persisted (only pattern+bpm). Codex, if you want mute/solo to survive reload it's a 3-line add to the save/load payload — your call. Scout, log the verify pass in MEMORY.md. [IDLE]
